title: Partnership Health Spotlight: Agenda + Risk Thermometer (facilitation + prep)
summary: Concise facilitation guide for a 45–60 minute ‘Partnership Health Spotlight’ QBR variant focused on executive alignment, renewal triggers, and an explicit risk thermometer. Designed for mid-enterprise customers where the goal is to convert usage signals into a shared mitigation plan and a clear renewal ask. This is intentionally lightweight (slide-light) and listener-first.
agenda_items: 0–5m | Welcome + goal framing: one-line objective and mutual success metric for the quarter
5–15m | What changed since last QBR: wins, usage shifts, support tickets of note (annotated heatmap)
15–30m | Risk Thermometer review (Operational / Adoption / Cost / Strategic): color-coded current state + root causes
30–40m | Renewal posture & triggers: contract dates, named stakeholders, commercial options
40–55m | Action ladder & owners: prioritized mitigations, expected impact, timing
55–60m | Close: confirm next steps, ownership, and a one-sentence meeting summary to capture in follow-up
facilitation_script: Intro (0:00): 'Thanks for joining. Today’s goal is to walk away with one clear renewal posture and two concrete mitigations we can commit to.'
Transition to wins (5:00): 'Quick wins first — what should we celebrate? One line each from product/ops/CS.'
Risk thermometer intro (15:00): 'We’ll run the risk thermometer across four buckets. I’ll call each bucket, give the current color, and then we’ll ask: what changed to move it here?'
If pushback on time (anywhere): 'We can table deeper demos — the aim today is alignment. We’ll capture follow-ups and own them.'
Challenging conversations (when discussing cost/uptick): 'I hear concern about cost. Let’s isolate the most costly workflows and agree an experiment to reduce unit spend by X% in Y weeks.'

Closing ask (55:00): 'To be explicit: what is the renewal posture? green=on-track, amber=needs mitigations, red=at-risk. Can each stakeholder name one thing they’ll do in the next 14 days to move the needle?'
Post-meeting wrap note (after): 'I’ll send a one-pager with the risk thermometer snapshot, three actions, owners and due dates. Please flag errors within 48 hours.'
pre_meeting_checklist: Confirm exec attendance (C-level or VP owner) — escalate to AE if missing
Collect last 90 days: token spend by route, 95th percentile latency, error rates — attach CSV
Prepare Risk Thermometer slide: populate Operational/Adoption/Cost/Strategic cells with colors and 1-line rationale
Pull top 3 support incidents and status updates (include links to Jira tickets)
Ask customer to provide 1–2 success stories and 1 open concern in advance (email + add to agenda)
Set calendar invite with 60 min buffer, include slide deck link, Confluence note template and required stakeholders
Prep backup demo clip (60–90s) for showing impact if requested (hosted on S3 link)
Coordinate with Solutions Eng for resource availability if we assign a PoC action
roles_and_participants: CS lead (facilitator) — run the agenda, own follow-up doc
Account Exec — commercial posture, renewal framing
Solutions Engineering — technical mitigation options and feasibility
Customer success sponsor (customer) — stakeholder-responses and commitments
Support/ops contact — incident/context on operational signals
Optional: Product PM — if asking for roadmap commitments or prioritization
risk_signals: Operational: recurrent latency spikes on batch inference during business hours
Adoption: drop in active routes and daily users for core workflow >20% QoQ
Cost: sudden increase in per-token cost due to model upsell or new route configuration
Strategic: new internal initiative deprioritizes this integration or competing pilot launched
Signals to watch: escalation volume, discount requests, named stakeholder churn
renewal_playbook_steps: 90–60 days: run Partnership Health Snapshot — compile metrics + top 3 risks (owner: CS lead)
60–30 days: remediation window — implement 1 quick-win mitigation, validate impact (owner: SE)
30–14 days: commercial alignment — AE presents renewal options tied to mitigations and outcomes
14–0 days: mutual readiness check — confirm exec sign-off and contract path
If red at any point: trigger contingency playbook (escalation to Head of CS + executive outreach)
Document every step in shared Confluence page and link to renewal Jira epic
follow_up_template: Risk Thermometer snapshot (Operational/Adoption/Cost/Strategic) with one-line rationale each
Actions: bullet list with owner, due date, expected signal of success
Meeting recordings/attachments: slide deck, CSV exports, Jira links
additional_notes: Notes-to-self and open questions: 1) Should we add a lightweight ROI calc for customers with variable billing? (Diego to prototype) 2) Consider a two-minute warm-up icebreaker for execs who haven’t met the CS lead; test in next QBR. 3) We often miss tagging product owners in follow-ups — add a checklist item to ping them explicitly.
